traits.name: Mangling Rend
traits.text: ⬺ A megaprimatus makes two fist Strikes against the same target. If both hit, the attack deals an additional 2d6 (2d6) bludgeoning damage, the target is flat-footed, and the target takes a –20-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Terrifying Display
traits.text: ⬺ (auditory, emotion, fear, mental); The megaprimatus beats its chest in a terrifying display. Creatures within 50 feet must attempt a DC 27 Will save. While a creature is frightened by this ability, it is flat-footed to the megaprimatus and to gorillas. Critical Success No effect and temporarily immune for 1 minute. Success The creature is unaffected. Failure The creature is frightened 1. Critical Failure The creature is frightened 2 and fleeing until the end of its next turn.
